I wrote the migrated file to `out/module.ts`. Type checking passes for it. `tsc` reports errors only in `src/module.ts`, because lodash isn't installed. I also couldn't measure the original's bundle size for the same reason, so I can't say how the 606 bytes compares.

| lodash | now | why |
|---|---|---|
| `keyBy` | `es-toolkit` `keyBy` | Same behaviour for numeric ids, which become string keys, with the last row winning on a duplicate id. |
| `sumBy(rows, 'age')` | `es-toolkit` `sumBy` with `(row) => row.age` | The strict version takes only a function, so the `'age'` shorthand became a one-line arrow. An empty array gives 0, as before. |
| `isEmpty` | `es-toolkit/compat` `isEmpty` | There is no strict `isEmpty`, only `isEmptyObject`, which doesn't cover null, numbers, strings or arrays. The compat version matches lodash for your input range. |

The bundle prints 606 bytes (min+gzip), of which 95 bytes is my own code. No lodash import is left, no hand-written replacements, and no other source files were created.
